title: incident-bot + slo-toolkit: enhanced automated diagnostics + runbook linking for on-call workflows
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Improve on-call productivity by enriching incident-bot alerts with context from SLO Toolkit diagnostics and direct links to runbooks. This PR wires together incident-bot and slo-toolkit diagnostics pipelines to attach a diagnostic summary and prioritized runbook links to high-severity alerts. Changes include: 1) a new diagnostics aggregation step that collects the latest SLO evaluation traces, recent error-rate change points, and relevant logs pointers; 2) a templating change in incident-bot to include a concise diagnostics block and 1-click runbook links in the alert payload; 3) rate-limit and privacy-safe redaction rules for diagnostic payloads; 4) tests and e2e simulations for the on-call flow. Implementation notes: - The diagnostics step subscribes to slo-toolkit’s diagnostics webhook and caches 5-minute windows for hot-paths to avoid extra load. - Runbook linkage is based on the SLO metadata mapping (slo_id -> runbook_url) maintained in the SLO Registry; fallback: a runbook search URL is provided when direct mapping is absent. - We keep payloads small: only top-3 signals and a short summary (<= 512 chars); longer payloads are available via a secure link to the diagnostics blob (signed URL). - Privacy: trace IDs are redacted where they might reference PII; logs pointers are high-level (service + stream) and require auth to follow. Rollout plan: feature-flag controlled (incident-bot flag: diagnostics_enrichment). Start with 25% of production alert traffic for 48h, monitor for false positives and SLO/do-not-alert regressions. Checklist: - [x] subscribe and transform slo-toolkit diagnostics webhook - [x] incident-bot templating + runbook links - [x] redaction and size limits - [x] unit tests for transformation logic - [x] integration test for enriched alert payloads - [x] e2e simulation w/ on-call flow - [x] feature flag + rollout steps Documentation: added a console doc (link in release notes) and inline code comments. Backwards compatibility: existing alert consumers will still receive the previous payload keys; diagnostics enrichment is additional fields behind the feature flag. CI: unit and integration tests included; one flaky e2e was stabilized. Related: Linear ENG-2782, ENG-3014, PM-499.
